summary: This is a routine earnings release filed on Form 6-K by HomesToLife Ltd, a Singapore-based furniture retailer, reporting unaudited Q1 2026 results. The filing highlights a 16% revenue increase to $92.5 million, 36% net profit rise to $3.2 million, and EPS of $0.036. It discusses segment performance, margin improvement, and provides FY2026 revenue guidance of $400-420 million. There are no event-driven special situation elements such as M&A, activist activity, or capital restructuring. The filing is an ordinary periodic report with no transformational corporate action.
